name: Familiar Keeper
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Find Familiar.

You always have the Find Familiar spell prepared. Additionally, you can cast it as a Magic action without expending a spell slot or Material components. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell (choose when you select this feat). Once you cast the spell using this benefit, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

Expanded Options.

When you cast Find Familiar, you can choose one of the normal forms for your familiar or one of the following special forms: Imp, Pseudodragon, Quasit, Sphinx of Wonder, or Sprite.

Familiar Distraction.

When a creature within 5 feet of your familiar makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to command your familiar to give the attack Disadvantage|XPHB. You impose Disadvantage|XPHB in this way a number of times equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Flex Caster
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Upcast.

When you cast a spell, such as Magic Missile, that can be cast with a higher-level spell slot for more powerful effects, you can expend any additional spell slot to increase the spell's effective level by 1, to a maximum of level 9.

Downcast.

When you cast a spell using a higher-level spell slot, you choose to recycle the excess magical energy instead of improving the spell. The spell is cast at its base level and you regain an expended level 1 spell slot.

name: Magitechnician
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Magic Item Expert.

If one of your magic items calls for a saving throw, it uses the following DC if it is higher: 8 plus the modifier of the ability increased by this feat and your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus.

Magic Item Recharge.

When you finish a Short Rest|XPHB, you can cause a magic item that regains charges or properties to recharge as if it were the next dawn. Once you use this trait, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Metabolistic Magic
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Arcane Skill.

When you fail a D20 Test|XPHB, you can expend a spell slot to gain a bonus to the roll, potentially causing it to succeed. The bonus equals 2 plus the level of the spell slot expended.

Vital Fuel.

When you finish a Short Rest|XPHB, you can expend a number of Hit Point Dice|XPHB up to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus to recover expended spell slots. Choose spell slots to recover that have a combined level equal to no more than the number of Hit Point Dice|XPHB expended. Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Pyromaniac
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Firestarter Magic.

You know the Fire Bolt cantrip and you always have the Burning Hands and Scorching Ray spells prepared. You can cast Burning Hands and Scorching Ray without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either spell in this way, you can't cast that spell in this way again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spellcasting ability for this feat's spells is the ability increased by this feat.

Flare Damage.

Whenever you deal Fire damage and roll the highest number on any damage die, you can roll that damage die again and add it to the damage, rolling again if it is the highest number, and so on. You can add a maximum number of dice to the damage roll equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus (minimum of 1).

name: Shock Trooper
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

First Strike.

When you roll Initiative|XPHB and don't have Disadvantage|XPHB on the roll, you can draw a weapon and make an attack using it.

Rapid Advance.

During the first round of each combat, your Speed|XPHB is doubled.

name: Showman
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Expert Performer.

You gain proficiency in the Performance skill. If you already have proficiency in it, you gain Expertise|XPHB in it.

Taunt.

You can take a Bonus Action|XPHB to mock a creature within 15 feet of yourself. If the target can hear you (though it need not understand you), it has Disadvantage|XPHB on the next attack roll it makes against a creature other than you before the end of its next turn. You can use this Bonus Action|XPHB a number of times equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

name: Spellblade
prerequisite: Level 4, INT 13; Level 4, WIS 13; Level 4, CHA 13
entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Blade Cantrips.

You learn two of the following cantrips of your choice: Arc Blade, Burning Blade, Frigid Blade, or True Strike. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose when you select this feat). Whenever you gain a new level, you can change your cantrip selection.

Arcane Strike.

When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can replace one of the attacks with casting Arc Blade, Burning Blade, Frigid Blade, or True Strike.

Channeled Attack.

When you make an attack using Strength or Dexterity with a weapon with which you have proficiency, you can gain a bonus to the attack roll equal to your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). Choose the ability each time you use this benefit. You can gain this bonus a number of times equal to your Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.
